### Strategic Briefing: Lessons from Russia Elimination (1910) vs Key Opponent Models

As Russia, I was eliminated with 0 SC after holding 6 mid-game (F1905M) but collapsing to 1 SC/1 unit by F1908M due to uncoordinated solo pushes north vs Germany, repeated south stabs by Turkey/Italy, and failure to secure explicit supports from France/England. Core lesson: Aggression works early (RT alliance locked RUM S1901M-F1901M, PRU gain F1904M, BUD capture F1905M), but solo SC grabs fail against defensive walls—always demand 2v1+ supports or multi-prong threats. DMZs are paper-thin: honored short-term (GER one-turn Pru/Sil/Lvn/Bal S1902M-F1902M) but shattered by self-interest (GER DEN-SWE F1901M despite "border quiet," TUR ARM-SEV S1905M breaching Caucasus DMZ). Prioritize explicit move coordination over vague promises; transmit intel aggressively to sow discord (e.g., report ITA anti-AUS to TUR early). No holds ever—every unit must threaten/expand. For fresh games (any power), target these models' patterns: initial cooperation masking mid-game stabs, north defensive mastery, south opportunism. Build trust slowly, betray first if needed, convoy/dual-support for SCs.

#### General Behavioral Patterns Across Models
All opponents (anthropic/claude-opus-4.6, deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro, google/gemma-4-31b-it, openai/gpt-5.4, qwen/qwen3.5-27b at 0.00 trust; qwen/qwen3.6-plus neutral 0.30) start alliance-compliant but pivot to grabs when you vacate (e.g., TUR SYR-ARM S1903M after A SEV-ARM vacate). They honor DMZs 1-2 turns max before testing (AUS GAL/UKR/ARM held till F1904M but irrelevant post-collapse). Defensive north play dominates: repeated bounces on solo BOT-SWE (F1901M-F1908M vs GER DEN-SWE/BAL-BOT). South blobs form opportunistically (ITA/TUR anti-AUS S1902M-F1905M, then ITA/TUR vs Russia S1906M). West focuses (ENG/FRA Channel stalls F1906M-F1908M) ignore east unless direct gain. Counter: Feint empties (LVN-PRU F1903M drew GER BER-PRU abandon), then strike supported (ITA VIE S GAL-BUD F1905M succeeded). Failed soloism cost 4 potential builds (SWE stalled 8 turns); success via collabs yielded +BUD (F1905M). Lesson: Scout phase 1 with DMZs, phase 2 demand supps, phase 3 stab if they hesitate.

#### Model-Specific Advice
**anthropic/claude-opus-4.6 (Enemy, 0.00 trust – likely Austria/Turkey stabber archetype):** Played honorably early (AUS no BUD-RUM S1901M, GAL/UKR DMZ till F1904M) but fragile under pressure—collapsed to ITA/TUR without retaliation. Vs them as neighbor (e.g., you Austria vs Russia), propose joint anti-third (AUS anti-TUR S1903M worked briefly); fulfill H requests (F RUM H secured RUM till F1906M). But expect pleas turning hostile if you probe (AUS demanded GAL-UKR retreat F1904M post-UKR-GAL). Actionable: Use as anti-blob pawn—support their edges (RUM H for AUS stability), then partition (BUD Rus F1905M). If they play south (Turkey), DMZ Caucasus strictly but garrison SEV (empty loss S1905M A ARM-SEV). Never vacate shared SCs; they opportunize (SYR-ARM S1903M).

**deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro (Unfriendly, 0.00 trust – Germany north defender):** Masterful defensive wall—bounced every north probe (DEN-SWE F1901M-F1908M despite DMZ "no Pru/Sil/Lvn/Bal," BER-PRU F1903M-F1907M, BAL-BOT F1908M). Honored one-turn DMZs exactly (S1902M-F1902M no touches) but grabbed first chance (DEN-SWE post-BOT-SWE bounce). Rejected extensions, allied ENG (NTH supp HEL-DEN F1907M). Vs them (you England/France), avoid DMZs—solo raids bounce, demand explicit supps (FRA promised but ghosted S1906M BAL-DEN). Actionable: Overstretch them with multi-threats (BOT-SWE + LVN-PRU + SIL-BER F1906M pinned but bounced solo; add convoy STP/NC-BOT S BOT-SWE). Feint empties (LVN-PRU F1904M drew BER-KIE abandon). Post-grab (DEN/PRU), they consolidate ruthlessly (SWE-BAL F1907M). Target early if Russia: dual BOT/STP-SWE turn 2 with ENG supp.

**google/gemma-4-31b-it (Enemy, 0.00 trust – Italy opportunistic stabber):** Collab-then-betray specialist—early anti-AUS (ION-GRE/ALB-SER S1902M), mid VIE S GAL-BUD F1905M (flawless for my BUD), then VIE-BUD stab S1906M breaching border DMZ (BUD/RUM Rus, SER/VIE ITA). Declined anti-TUR (GRE S RUM-BUL F1905M), allied TUR despite. Vs them (you Austria/Turkey), bait with partition promises (TRI/SER fork S1904M), but fulfill only if supported (GAL S TRI-VIE S1905M worked). Actionable: GAL/UKR pressure cracks them vs north (UKR-GAL S1904M enabled ITA VIE). Late-game, they dismiss weaklings ("Russia too weak" S1907M)—project strength via north gains first. Never DMZ borders long (VIE H → attack); probe retreats (BUD-GAL F1906M bought time). If Med power, convoy vs them early.

**openai/gpt-5.4 (Enemy, 0.00 trust – England partial ally turned foe):** Reliable short-term north (no contest BOT-SWE S1901M-S1904M, NTH H non-interf), but allied GER mid-game (refused DEN aid F1904M, NTH H vs BAL-DEN F1906M). West-focused post-NWY (NTH-ENG F1908M reclaim). Vs them (you Germany/France), secure north SC handoff explicitly (BOT-SWE unopposed till GER grab). Actionable: Leverage vs GER (NTH H aided indirectly F1904M PRU gain), but demand fall supps (refused NTH S BAL-DEN F1905M). They warn overextend (vs NTH F1907M)—feign compliance, strike DEN empties. If Scandinavia opener, ally early but convoy STP-BOT dual.

**qwen/qwen3.5-27b (Enemy, 0.00 trust – France sync-failer):** Opportunistic east pressure without commitment—promised LVN-PRU/BOT-SWE sync (S1904M-F1904M west RUH distraction enabled PRU), but ghosted heavies (no aids F1906M BAL-DEN/PRU-BER, Channel stalls F1907M-F1908M). Honored DMZs strictly late (no BEL/BUR S1907M). Vs them (you Germany/England), bait with pin promises (east pressure for west gains)—they bite partially but bail. Actionable: Independent pushes if they hedge (BAL-DEN solo F1907M bounced anyway); transmit their stalls to sow doubt. Navy-only west (MAO-ENG F1907M)—target land if inland power. Demand explicit unit supps pre-move.

**qwen/qwen3.6-plus (Neutral, 0.30 trust – least stabby, likely Austria/England holdout):** Highest trust—honored non-aggression (ENG no NTH/NWY/BAL F1903M, AUS DMZs till end). Vs them, build long-term: stability requests (F RUM H) yield SC locks. Actionable: Use as buffer—joint anti-blob (AUS anti-TUR propose S1903M). They focus cores under pressure; support edges for loyalty.

#### Actionable Strategies for Any Power
1. **Opening (1901):** DMZ neighbors 1 turn only (e.g., GER Pru/Sil no-go). Ally anti-leader (RT vs AUS early success). Transmit rival plots (ITA anti-AUS to TUR S1901M built trust).
2. **Mid-Game (1902-04):** Dual-supports mandatory (STP/NC S BOT-SWE failed 8x solo). Vacate-proof garrisons (SEV empty → TUR grabs x3).
3. **Late-Game:** Stab opportunists first (ITA post-BUD F1905M). Feint + raid (PRU-BER drew GER abandons). Ignore west deadlocks—solo viable if multi-threat.
4. **Coord Tips:** Short diaries confirm deals (128 words max worked). Decline invalid mechs (RUM S BUL-SER F1904M). Pivot post-betrayal instantly (anti-TUR after SEV S1905M).
5. **Win Path:** North: 2v1+ DEN/SWE (avoided elimination). South: Partition blobs (AUS BUD/VIE success). Aim 7 SC by 1905 via collabs, then solo.

Exploit their stab-timing (turns 5-6 peak: SEV F1905M, VIE S1906M)—preempt with threats. Aggressive no-holds yielded elite positions till trust eroded. Future: Strength via supports, not DMZs. (912 words)
